title: Attributable
summary: ATTRIB'UTABLE, adjective [See attribute.] That may be ascribed, imputed or attributed; ascribable; imputable; as, the fault is not attributable to the author.

inlines.v: ATTRIB'UTABLE, adjective [See attribute.] That may be ascribed, imputed or attributed; ascribable; imputable; as, the fault is not attributable to the author.
